title: Tech Note: Customizing the 4D Form Wizard

historical_commentary.text: This note explains how to override the Form Wizard's default template graphics with custom resources, noting a platform quirk where Mac OS-based resources are supported on both Mac and Windows, but only Macintosh has the editing utilities, so the example must be followed on a Mac; both the Form Wizard and classic Mac OS resource-file-based customization are long obsolete, tied to a form-templating and cross-platform resource model that predates modern 4D form design.
related_updates: The V6-era Form Wizard and its resource-based template customization have been superseded by newer 4D form design tools and capabilities
Classic Mac OS resource files/editing utilities referenced here are obsolete since Mac OS X abandoned the classic resource fork model
